scope: Reproduces campaign source state, producer/reconstruction identity, quality reason, features, baseline, and source lineage for the sampled decisions whose source ordinals are in the captured finalized segment prefix. It also summarizes campaign window book-update intervals by market, excluding intervals that span a recorded gap or unsupported source frame; aligns market updates, scheduled decisions, and aggregated gap issue labels by five-minute family block, mapping issue entries to campaign market IDs and YES/NO outcomes without exporting asset identifiers. It also reports allowlisted configuration fields from finalized collector process-start records, excluding storage paths. It also compares campaign gap issue ages and scheduled per-outcome ages with preceding same-gap-epoch book updates, censoring missing or pre-gap updates. It does not infer omitted decisions, fills, or outcomes.
